basic_profile.bio: I'm a 30-year-old tech enthusiast based in Austin, Texas. By day, I'm a freelance graphic designer, and in the evenings, I unwind by exploring new games with my girlfriend. While I enjoy a good FPS, I'm always on the lookout for cooperative multiplayer experiences that we can enjoy together. I'm fairly new to Reddit, still finding my way around. I typically browse in the late evenings after work, around 9 PM to midnight. Currently in a committed relationship, and we're all about budget-friendly gaming!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, which I pursued through online courses and self-study. I've been passionate about technology and gaming since my teenage years, always eager to try out new gadgets and games.
